topologyPolicy.decision: Use route groups for walked official route topology and connections for transfers between route entries.

routeGroupKinds.mainline: Primary continuous official section chain for the selected trail model.
routeGroupKinds.branch: Official alternate or side branch that can be hiked as trail, but should not be silently merged into the mainline.
routeGroupKinds.access: Official or strongly supported approach route to/from public transport, village, trailhead or another trail.
routeGroupKinds.connector: Walked link between route groups or nearby route sections where it is part of the trail model.

topologyPolicy.connectionsUse: Use connections.json-style records for non-section transfers or continuity records between sections: ferry, bus, road transfer, rowboat, short walk transfer, same-island continuity, or mode none for a known gap with no usable transfer geometry.
topologyPolicy.officialRowboatRule: If a rowboat crossing is an official route entry in its own right, model it as a section route with strong warnings. Otherwise model it as a rowboat connection or access/side metadata.

actions: Review caveats-resolution.research.json together with the 10 section research files before any normalization work.
Map each section to officialDisplayDistance, computedGeometryKm, geometrySource, split indices, endpoint snap policy, access connectors, and facility import actions.

decisionsApplied.decision: Do not publish a single official headline distance yet; use section-level display distances and preserve the 140/150/150-160/160 km source claims until geometry split review.

Use researched OSM relation geometry for stages 1-2 because the Naturkartan records are grouped or access-mixed; use Naturkartan GPX splits/reversals for stages 3-10, preserving route-line endpoints instead of inventing hut-centroid connectors.

Keep M/S Storlule, Bobäcken-Kvikkjokk, helicopter access, Virihaure local boats and the Gamájåhkå walking alternative as access/description metadata for the initial runtime import, not seamless walking geometry.

Import normal hut/service records where coordinates are explicit; attach or suppress weak standalone hut amenities, and keep seasonal opening/payment/stock conditions in descriptions and publication-time checks.

connections.importPolicy: Keep M/S Storlule and trailhead boat access as connector/access metadata, not walking route geometry.
Keep Kvikkjokk-Bobäcken boat logistics in the description/connector layer until runtime connector support exists.

displayPolicies.contradictionPolicy: Suppress single headline total; show section distances and source-claim caveats.

remainingGeometryWork: Run publication-time checks for volatile boats, helicopter access, hut openings, bridge status, fire bans, protected-area notices and gateway transit before exposing the route as final.
